snippet.title: Yondel – Official Gameplay Reveal (Co-op & Combat)
snippet.description:
Build, farm, craft, mine, cook, fight, and survive together in Yondel—a pixel survival adventure set in an infinite procedurally generated world.

Play Yondel now in Steam Early Access

Captured in Early Access Update 0.4.5, this gameplay trailer showcases:

• Online co-op survival
• Farming and resource gathering
• Base building and crafting
• Underground mining and exploration
• Combat against strange creatures
• Cooking and survival systems
• Anvil forging and equipment progression
• Real-time sunlight and shadows
• Updated water and building placement previews

Yondel is developed by Veejay / Martal Games and published by ORCA.

Subscribe and follow Yondel’s journey through Early Access!

#Yondel #PixelArtGame #SurvivalGame
